name: pdk-saleor-discounted-price-convergence
instr:
Saleor currently recalculates catalogue discounts in the background, but overlapping price edits, promotion edits and workers can leave storefront prices stale or emit duplicate price-update webhooks. Fix the GraphQL write paths, PostgreSQL state and Celery processing so a committed variant base-price edit, catalogue promotion or rule creation or deletion, rule update, or promotion date update converges to the correct variant `pricing.price` and product `pricing.priceRange` within 30 seconds. Several workers may process simultaneously, and a worker may be killed during recalculation; when one restarts, all affected listings must become clean and show the last committed prices within 30 seconds. A concurrent edit must not be overwritten by an older calculation, including when another listing of the same product is row-locked during the calculation.

Each effective discounted-price change must emit exactly one `PRODUCT_VARIANT_DISCOUNTED_PRICE_UPDATED` webhook for each affected variant/channel, after its price commits. Deliveries for one variant/channel must follow committed price changes, contain the committed previous/new amounts, and retain Saleor's existing webhook event name and payload shape; an unchanged recalculation emits nothing. The existing subscription payload includes `productVariant.id`, `channel.slug`, and `previousPrice` and `newPrice` with `amount` and `currency`; the delivery uses the `X-Saleor-Event: product_variant_discounted_price_updated` header.
